title: Mixed Event — Don't lose faith! — Episode6 The Promised Day

meta.Event Outline: Now that Shiho has passionately declared that they'll let their music do the talking, she and the rest of Leo/need decide to ramp up their practice in the month leading up to their next show. When that proves to be insufficient, Shiho proposes an intense training program in SEKAI!

rows.Line: The next day
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Morning, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, Shiho, morning!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We finally get to practice as a band...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I-I'm a little nervous.
It feels like it's been so long since we last did...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, I had trouble falling asleep last night because I was so anxious! A part of me was worried about how we'd do today after practicing so much...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I also can't wait to play as a band! So, let's start already!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Your mind must be made of steel, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(Miku's right...
I'm also really nervous about this.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But this will tell us where we are as a band. I have to think that the others are gonna play with everything they have, so...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Let's play like it's the real thing.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Then, we'll watch as you girls play.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I think we're all looking forward to hearing you play as a band since it's been so long.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(I'm so nervous...
I haven't felt this way in such a long time...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I can feel all this anxiety and excitement whirling around inside me... It reminds me of the time when we first played as a band.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I can't honestly say how well we're going to do... But I should just try to enjoy the moment and do everything I practiced.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I gotta play with everything I have...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Here they go...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Ichika's singing the high notes with so much power. Normally, her voice can sound thin in high keys, but she's belting it.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (The drums and keyboard are in perfect rhythm... They sound totally different from before...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (They must've practiced so much.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (They're way beyond the level I expected.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (They're playing really great, but...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(What do I do...?
Shiho's just way too good on her bass.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Not just good...
She seems so far ahead of us in terms of skill.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(This isn't cutting it...
I can't keep up with Shiho...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But... But I...!)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (There's no way that crowd's going to feel anything from our performance if we're this disparate...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But it's okay... We still have time before our show...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(Plus, they've all gotten this good.
So, as long as we practice like we mean it until then...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
They've really been putting in the effort.
Ichi cut her finger after playing her guitar too much and I heard that Hona cracked one of her drumsticks!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Weird, right?!
The Sakki I know is usually snacks first, work later.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. Sorry...
Moving so suddenly made me feel a little light-headed...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Can I really ask them to do more...?)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (They're all giving it their best. No, they're doing better than that. These past couple of weeks, they've been doing absolutely everything they possibly could.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(Ichika, Saki, Honami...
Any one of them could've collapsed or fallen ill during these intense training sessions.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I can't ask them to do more...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (At the same time, we can't go on stage in this state. We're too out of sync.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (We're not in a band and playing music for fun. We want others to be moved by the songs we play.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (We need to produce a stage-worthy sound. Which means, I...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I have to play at their level...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Shih...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, don't!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Why are you holding back?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, we're still nowhere near your skill level. You're so far ahead of us...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
But I don't want you to hold back.
That's why we practiced so much until now!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I... I get what you're trying to do, Shih...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm guessing that you think you'll stand out if you play at 100% and fall out of sync with everyone...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That actually crossed my mind when I heard you play...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(Now it makes sense...
Rin knew this would happen.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sorry...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But all of you could tell that we sounded really off-balance just now, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: At this rate, we won't be able to put on a good performance. So, I have to hold back. It's just what's best for us...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, it's not what's best for us!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: If you want what's best for us, play like you really mean it. Only then...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We'll be able to reach your level, Shiho...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: She's right...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I think it's fair to say that we all knew you'd be playing at a different level compared to us, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's why we agreed to do these training sessions. We wanted to catch up to you... However, in hindsight, we didn't have much of a chance to do that since you were practicing just as hard.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: At the same time, Shiho, I don't want you to not play with everything you have...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, me too...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The truth is, Shiho, I got to get a peek at how you were practicing the other day...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You looked like you were having so much fun playing your bass... I'm never gonna forget that sound.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And you produced the same sort of sound just now as we played. I felt that same excitement from before. So...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I think it's important to capture that excitement. I think it's what Leo/need really needs.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I mean, it's what we've been trying to translate into sound up to this point. That's why you shouldn't let that feeling go...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But... At this rate...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We all know that it isn't going to be easy.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: For us to reach your level, Shiho, we'll probably have to spend less time eating and sleeping in order to practice.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Even so...
I want to make that happen before our show.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You make it sound so simple...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
But that's easier said than done.
Until now, we've been practicing with everything we have without cutting any corners.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
But to ask you to do even more...
What if one of you collapses from exhaustion before our show...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I don't care.
I'd rather have that happen than regret not practicing as hard as I could've.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I agree...
I mean, that's what we all initially agreed to do.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: If we can't reach your level, Shiho, then it just means that we still have work to do. I don't think there's anything you can really do about that. However...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We promise to do everything we can to not make you worry, so please, don't take your foot off the accelerator.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, I promise too!
Yes, you're way ahead of us right now, Shiho, but just wait... We're gonna catch up to you in no time!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: By the time the day of our show rolls around, we'll be standing shoulder-to-shoulder with you...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Then, we can run across the finish line hand in hand, like that race we did way back when!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: All of you...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You know this isn't gonna be easy, right...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (They've stuck with me until now.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Before we formed our band, when I asked for them to play a tough song, when I wasn't sure about actually going pro... Even now...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Wait, I...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(This is just who they are...
I decided that I wanted to go pro with this band because they throw themselves at everything head-on.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(Not anyone else.
I don't care how long it takes. I want the four of us to go pro together.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (And they're all doing their best to keep up with me. They don't want me to treat them with kid gloves.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Then... Then, I...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I wouldn't mind running like that again...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Shiho...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Sorry...
I didn't realize just how serious you all were.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Even though you practiced as hard as you could up until today, I didn't have faith in you...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I'm gonna play like I mean it.
So, let's make our next performance one to remember...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Does this mean you'll be back to practicing as per usual?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But we don't have time to individually practice playing our instruments. Moving forward, we're gonna need to play as much as we can as a band and push each other to do better.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Try to keep up with me, okay?

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Honami & Saki
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Thank goodness. They all seem in better spirits now...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
The thing is, the other day...
When I thought I was assigned to Shih when it was actually your day, KAITO, I wasn't sure what to say after I heard the way she played...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I realized that Leo/need wouldn't really sound like Leo/need if Shih didn't play like she really meant it!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But I couldn't think of a good way to say that or any good solutions for that matter...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I understand how you feel...
I also sensed the same thing that time. But...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I had a feeling that the girls would figure out a way without me saying anything...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Through thick and thin, they've pressed on and kept believing in one another.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I remember thinking before how beautiful your singing voice was, Rin, and how you sang high notes with so much power...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's like your voice could break through the ceiling. Can you teach me how to do that? This song we're working on now has some high parts and I want to get it right.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Because if I don't, I probably won't feel too confident when I'm on stage. Plus...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: My singing and guitar-playing pale in comparison to what Shiho can do.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (That's right. Ichi's been saying that she wants to figure out a way to reach Shih's level...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (And KAITO didn't stop her because he already knew that...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Y-Yes?
Is something...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Nope!
I just thought that you're really amazing, KAITO♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (But thankfully...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Things should turn out great now!)
